title: OrchestratorDecisionRecord
description: One typed decision the ReviewDecisionOrchestrator made about an auto-review job. Append-only entry in {workspace}/logs/decisions/{project}.jsonl. Mirrors backend/Features/Runner/ReviewDecisionRecord.cs::ReviewDecisionRecord.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the decision was emitted.

jobId.description: Slug-form job id of the 4-review task the decision targeted.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

kind.description: Action or explicit operator boundary. 'Skipped' leaves the task untouched for the next tick. 'OperatorRequeue' opens a fresh attempt epoch after a human moves a task out of Human Review or Escalated.

reason.description: One short sentence the orchestrator emitted as the rationale. Plain prose, no markdown.

prompt.description: Full rendered prompt that was sent to the fast-model session, captured for Layer 3 audit.

response.description: Raw stdout captured from the fast-model session, including the decision sentinel and any narrative around it.

followUp.description: For Reissue, the follow-up text the orchestrator wrote back into the chat log and the orchestrator-follow-up.md file in the job folder. Empty string for the other kinds.

attemptChainId.description: Optional stable identity for a gate retry chain.

subjectSha.description: Optional immutable git subject assessed by the gate.

failureFingerprint.description: Optional normalized failure identity used by bounded retry guards.

failureFingerprints.description: All normalized aspect-block identities in this review round. This lets one unchanged aspect reach its convergence bound while unrelated aspect findings change.

attemptEpoch.description: Operator-owned review-attempt epoch. Legacy rows without the field belong to epoch 0; only an explicit human requeue opens the next epoch.
